operation_details.item: The user pitched a group of investors in the roadshow.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How did the investor roadshow go this week?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It went well—I pitched a group of investors in the roadshow and got some thoughtful questions.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Nice. Was the pitch deck ready for those meetings?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes, the pitch deck is finalized, and I felt comfortable presenting it.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Did you also have the numbers prepared to support the discussion?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I did. The financial model has been updated, so I could walk through the assumptions and projections.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What’s next now that the roadshow is done?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Follow-up meetings are scheduled with several investors, so I’m organizing notes and preparing for those conversations.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please forget only that I pitched investors in the roadshow; keep the deck, financial model, and follow-up meetings.
